risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Training, security incidents may not be detected, contained, investigated or communicated in a timely manner, increasing their scope, duration and cost. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Protection (DCH-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Training (IRO-20.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Response
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to respond to sensitive and/or regulated data spills.
compensating_control_2.justification: Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Response (IRO-20) provides incident response capability that compensates for the absence of Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Training (IRO-20.2) by enabling timely detection, containment, and recovery from security events in the absence of the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
